sources.finding: Microsoft labels 5003 'Bootstrapper failed to download installer'; installer bootstrap precedes product installation. noWeb prevents acquiring missing product content; certificates required offline.

findings: Offline clients may need current Microsoft roots/intermediates; cannot refresh automatically online.
Layout Certificates contains Microsoft Root Certificate Authority 2011 and 2010.
Maintaining offline machine section links Microsoft Windows Code Signing PCA 2024.
Certificates in CurrentUser are not automatically available to other users.

latest_user_evidence: Screenshot gives 5003 only; previous InvalidCertificate does not establish the latest root cause.
